answer: To fight Sybil attacks, recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and sequential delay functions build a lattice where identity ascends from the computational nadir to a crystal of consensus. Binding pseudonyms through temporal delay primitives renders identity cloning computationally infeasible, preventing an attacker from reaching the strategic ledge of equivocation without proof. Strict finality emerges via Byzantine fault tolerance; explicit slashing penalties on staked collateral enforce negative expected adversary utility, securing robust Nash equilibrium.
